stories.title: How are voters feeling before Election Day?
stories.take: The answer: Democrats lead by 8 points on the generic ballot among likely voters, and Trump's approval is 38% with registered voters (40% with likely voters) • Cost of living is the top concern (just over a third of likely voters), then preserving democracy (~33%), immigration (~21%), foreign policy (~12%) and health care (~5%) • Enthusiasm favors Democrats — 71% 'very enthusiastic' vs. 61% of Republicans — though younger and non-white voters lag • 53% strongly oppose Trump's job performance, the highest on record, but toss-up races in Trump-won districts could still limit Democratic gains
